tryon.active_camera_status: Face tracking active hai. Is frame ka fit mode tayyar ho raha hai.
tryon.camera_permission_status: Private camera preview start karein taake on-device fit check tayyar ho.
tryon.copy_error: Copy nahi ho saka. Mobile par try-on kholne ke liye product link ke sath ?tryon=1 use karein.
tryon.copy_success: Mobile try-on link copy ho gaya.
tryon.desktop_status: Is frame ka private camera try-on mobile par kholne ke liye code scan karein.
tryon.loading_status: Camera preview start ho raha hai.
tryon.model_active_status: 3D frame aapke face ko track kar raha hai. Behtareen fit ke liye face center mein rakhein.
tryon.model_error_status: Face tracking active hai. 3D frame model load nahi ho saka, is liye fit guide dikh rahi hai.
tryon.fit_active_status: Face measurements active hain. Behtareen fit check ke liye face center mein rakhein.
tryon.missing_assets: Try-on enable karne ke liye 3D model, transparent 2D try-on image, ya frame measurements add karein.
tryon.missing_model: Product 3D model add karein, eyesaloon.model_3d metafield set karein, ya is app block mein GLB URL paste karein.
tryon.no_camera_status: Camera access available nahi hai ya block ho gaya. Aap mobile try-on link copy karke dobara try kar sakte hain.
tryon.no_model_status: Is product ke liye try-on ko 3D model, transparent 2D frame image, ya frame measurements chahiye.
tryon.pd_help: Optional. Calibrated scale ke liye apni prescription ka total PD use karein.
tryon.profile_ready_status: Fit profile is phone par save ho gaya. Aap ise doosre frames par use kar sakte hain.
tryon.privacy_chip: Camera device par hi rehta hai
tryon.qr_error_status: QR generate nahi ho saka. Mobile link copy karein.
tryon.qr_label: Mobile try-on ke liye QR code
tryon.ready_status: Aapka try-on preview yahan load hoga.
tryon.runtime_error_status: Try-on preview start nahi ho saka. Band karke dobara try karein.
tryon.selfie_preview_alt: Try-on fallback ke liye uploaded selfie
tryon.selfie_preview_status: Selfie preview load ho gaya. Live face tracking ke liye camera access zaroori hai.
tryon.tracking_assets_missing_status: Camera preview tayyar hai. Face tracking assets abhi installed nahi hain.
tryon.unsupported_status: Yeh browser try-on preview nahi chala sakta. Camera, WebGL, aur WebAssembly support wala latest mobile browser try karein.
